hook.firstFrame: Photograph of an IndianOil gas station with bold text comparing car purchase to opening a petrol pump.

shots.picture: Static graphic showing petrol station, business earnings breakdown list, floating emoji reactions, and subscription bar.

ending.lastFrame: Static graphic detailing petrol pump financials with subscription banner at bottom.

whyItWorks: Contrasting a luxury asset purchase with a cash-flowing business investment creates strong initial curiosity.
Presenting full income and expense figures in a bulleted list makes complex unit economics easily readable.
A readable static layout encourages audience pausing and re-watching, boosting overall view retention.
